events.command:
/bin/bash -lc "cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, urllib.request, csv
url='https://www.encodeproject.org/search/?searchTerm=AFGR&type=Experiment&assay_term_name=ATAC-seq&format=json&limit=all&frame=embedded'
with urllib.request.urlopen(url) as r:
    d=json.load(r)
exps=d['@graph']
print('experiments',len(exps))
rows=[]
for e in exps:
    sample=e.get('biosample_summary','').replace('Homo sapiens ','').strip()
    for f in e.get('files',[]):
        if f.get('file_format')=='bam' and f.get('output_type')=='alignments' and f.get('assembly')=='GRCh38' and f.get('status')=='released':
            rows.append((sample,e['accession'],f['accession'],f['md5sum']))
print('bam alignments',len(rows))
# duplicates?
from collections import Counter
print('samples',len(set(r[0] for r in rows)), Counter(r[0] for r in rows).most_common(5))
# 1000g
samples=set()
for line in open('kgp_3202_samples.tsv'):
    if line.startswith('FamilyID'): continue
    p=line.split('\\t')
    samples.add(p[1])
inter=[r for r in rows if r[0] in samples]
print('inter',len(inter), 'unique samples', len(set(r[0] for r in inter)))
missing=[r for r in rows if r[0] not in samples]
print('missing',len(missing), missing[:20])
# md5s sorted
m=sorted(r[3] for r in inter)
print('md5 count',len(m), 'unique md5',len(set(m)))
print('\\n'.join(m[:5]))
open('expected_md5s.txt','w').write('\\n'.join(m)+'\\n')
PY
md5sum expected_md5s.txt
wc -l expected_md5s.txt"

import json, urllib.request
from collections import Counter
url='https://www.encodeproject.org/search/?searchTerm=AFGR&type=Experiment&assay_term_name=ATAC-seq&format=json&limit=all&frame=embedded'

rows=[]
for e in exps:
    sample=e.get('biosample_summary','').replace('Homo sapiens ','').strip()
    for f in e.get('files',[]):
        if f.get('file_format')=='bam' and f.get('output_type')=='alignments' and f.get('assembly')=='GRCh38' and f.get('status')=='released':
            rows.append((sample,e['accession'],f['accession'],f['md5sum']))
print('bam alignments',len(rows),'samples',len(set(r[0] for r in rows)))
samples=set()
for line in open('kgp_3202_samples.tsv'):
    p=line.split()
    if p and p[0]=='FamilyID': continue
    if len(p)>1: samples.add(p[1])
print('1000g samples',len(samples))
inter=[r for r in rows if r[0] in samples]
missing=[r for r in rows if r[0] not in samples]

m=sorted(r[3] for r in inter)
print('md5 count',len(m),'unique md5',len(set(m)))
open('expected_md5s.txt','w').write('\\n'.join(m)+'\\n')
print('\\n'.join(m[:5]))
PY
